offer.title: Entry-level AppSec Engineer
offer.job_text: Permanent entry-level application security role in Lausanne. Recent graduates are welcome and no previous full-time employment is needed. You review Python applications with Burp Suite and SonarQube, check OWASP issues and help maintain CI security controls. A security engineer provides structured mentoring, and the scope of the application team is specified in the employment offer.
